scope: Agent visual review, not independent designer signoff or Figma pixel certification

routes.recents: Files remains the comparison screen: icon/text size, theme foreground, grid filters and card radius remain consistent.
routes.building: Service icon sizes and foreground now follow controls; original dollar artwork, identities and document geometry are retained. No inspector exists on this screen.
routes.chat: Sidebar/header/composer glyphs scale together. Activity metadata adopts section16/row8 spacing; identity images and the document remain independent.
routes.sandbox: Section titles use label/default; align icons now have consistent optical bounds and source alpha. Fields remain aligned; extreme groups wrap and inspector scrolls.
routes.spline: Object Transform inspector uses section16/axis8 spacing; at extreme density it stacks below the viewport. Material thumbnails and procedural scene remain independent.
routes.webflow: Original composite glyph hierarchy is retained with normalized whole-silhouette bounds/alpha and currentColor. Inspector section16/property4/grid8; extreme header wraps.
routes.framer: Inspector detail headings use label/default instead of oversized panel role; section16/property4 spacing. Header glyphs scale with SEDA slots; authored iframes remain independent.
routes.workflow: Node/context glyphs follow control slots and theme; consistent inspector sections and headings. At extreme density panels scroll and toolbar overflow remains local.

limitations: 95 initial-state glyph variants painted; other source variants are measured/hashed but not all interaction states raster-certified
Original source stroke style retained; this does not turn all source families into a single new icon catalog
Extreme XL/150/X24/Y12 is a stress scenario requiring local scrolling, not the recommended default application density

productionReview.result: Live Sandbox/Webflow visually reviewed in both themes; same glyph contrast/geometry and inspector rhythm as local. No tooltip overlays in final frames.
